video.title: AI欧腐《与F1宿敌的颠簸情路/Rough Ride with my F1 Rival》
video.desc:
依旧princess
What happens when your biggest rival becomes your billionaire boss? F1 enemies Kyle and Chase clash fiercely on track. Drowning in debt, Kyle unknowingly signs to be Chase's live-in training driver. Their hatred soon ignites into a secret romance. But when a malicious leak exposes their affair, Kyle faces an impossible choice: betray Chase to save his racing career, or stand by the rival who stole his heart.

当你最大的死对头变成了你的亿万富翁老板，会发生什么？F1赛场上的宿敌Kyle和Chase在赛道上针锋相对、水火不容。债台高筑的Kyle在毫不知情的情况下签下合约，成了Chase的同居陪练车手。两人之间的恨意很快燃烧成一段隐秘的恋情。然而，一场恶意爆料让他们的地下情曝光，Kyle面临着两难抉择：是背叛Chase以保住自己的赛车生涯，还是坚定地站在这个偷走他心的宿敌身边？
